fields.name: TEST Priya
fields.notes_from_call: Wants modular kitchen and wardrobes; likes warm wood tones.

summary: TEST call. Priya, 3BHK in Kothrud (1,400 sq ft), full home design + execution, needs it complete by end of March 2027. Booked a consultation.
transcript:
Agent: Hello, Aangan Studio — I'm the studio's assistant. This call is recorded so our designers have your details. How can I help?
Caller: Hi, I've just bought a 3BHK in Kothrud and want the whole flat done — design and execution.
Agent: Lovely. May I have your name?
Caller: Priya.
Agent: Where exactly is the flat, and roughly how big?
Caller: Dahanukar Colony, about 1,400 square feet carpet.
Agent: When would you need the project complete?
Caller: By end of March next year.
Agent: Are you the one deciding on this?
Caller: Yes.
Agent: Anything specific in mind?
Caller: A modular kitchen, wardrobes, warm wood tones.
Agent: Our designer is free at the times I'm about to offer — which one works best for you?
Caller: The first one.
